name: After § 8
title: REPORT on the Council position on Draft amending budget No 2/2026 of the European Union for the financial year 2026 – Update on revenue (own resources) and adjustments to expenditure
part_text: 8a. Underlines that any savings resulting from the withdrawal, suspension or abandonment of Union legislative initiatives should be used as a matter of priority to reduce the GNI-based contributions of Member States; opposes the use of such savings to finance new expenditure or to further expand the scope of the Union budget;
